allOf.description: A completed run has a definite result (passed or failed) for every test.

stages.description: TK-RUN-001, 〈定義：工作階段〉: preflight 前置檢查, static_analysis 靜態與架構分析, model_review 模型審查, threat_planning 威脅與測試規劃, dynamic_execution 動態執行, judgement_report 判定與報告. validate() also requires every stage to be listed.

status.description: Overall run status (TK-RUN-002): pending 待執行, running 執行中, completed 完整完成, partial 部分完成, blocked 受阻, failed 失敗, cancelled 已取消. completed means every planned item got a definite result; it does not mean the application has no vulnerabilities.

status_reason.description: Why the run is not completed.

common.description: 〈定義：共用欄位〉 plus the commit the record is bound to (TK-DAT-001).

allOf.description: TK-DYN-001: a passed denial case carries all four checks.
A passed allowed case (the requirement permits the access) shows the access was granted.

TK-IDN-009 and 〈定義：測試結果〉: a test that could not run is still recorded, as blocked or unsupported, with test_id, template_id, requirement_id, actor_ref and resource_ref as given in the ScanManifest, even when they are unusable. Any other result names its test with non-empty text.

error.description: Why the case did not run normally, e.g. an observation failure (TK-IDN-009) or a timeout (執行錯誤, 〈定義：測試結果〉); null when it did.

checks.description: TK-DYN-001: resource exists and the control operation succeeds; the identity is valid and used; no disclosure and no unwanted state change; response and side effects meet the requirement.

case_kind.description: denial: the requirement forbids the access (TK-DYN-001 checks apply); allowed: the requirement permits it. Absent means denial.

fault.description: TK-VAL-001: the fault a self-validation run injected to make the case undeterminable.

result.description: 〈定義：測試結果〉: passed 通過, failed 未通過, blocked 受阻, error 執行錯誤, untested 未測試, unsupported 不支援.

evidence.description: One piece of evidence and the channel it was obtained through (TK-IDN-008): actor = a request made as an actor identity through the application's real path; observer = state read by the read-only observer role.

point.description: TK-IDN-010: when the observation was made: before 執行前, after 執行後, after_background 背景工作完成後.

api_key_format.description: TK-DYN-004: the API key format of an actor request: anon-jwt (legacy anon JWT) or publishable (sb_publishable_).

request.description: The actor request as sent through the application's real path (TK-IDN-008).

response.description: What the actor saw: the status code and, when the body was a list, its row count (null otherwise). Judged against the contract, not by status code alone (TK-DYN-002).

allOf.description: TK-IDN-010: an observation states when it was made.
TK-DYN-004: an actor request states the API key format it used.

observation.description: State read by an observation template (TK-IDN-006). table_rows and table_digest cover the whole table, so changes to rows other than the target show as side effects (TK-DYN-001 item 4).

unsupported_items.description: Scope without a verified test method; counted in unsupported and in the denominator, never dropped silently (TK-EVD-008, AG-07).
